styles.name: sword-draw
styles.description: A longsword drawn from a leather scabbard: pommel, grip and gold crossguard pull clear as the steel blade emerges, a glint running its edge

styles.name: bow-draw
styles.description: A wooden longbow drawn back by progress: the stave bends, the string pulls to a point behind a fletched arrow aimed at a target; at 100% the arrow flies

styles.name: castle-build
styles.description: A stone castle — crenellated towers, curtain walls and a gated keep — rises course by course from the ground; blocks drop onto the fresh course and banners fly when complete

styles.name: trebuchet-launch
styles.description: A wooden trebuchet swings its arm as the iron counterweight drops, hurling a boulder along a dotted arc; progress pushes the target flag further downrange

styles.name: shield-charge
styles.description: A row of heater shields, iron outlines filling one by one with heraldic colours around a cross charge; a glint sweeps across the finished shields

styles.name: jousting
styles.description: Two armoured knights on caparisoned horses gallop toward each other with striped lances couched; they close with progress and the lances splinter on impact at 100%

styles.name: drawbridge
styles.description: A wooden drawbridge lowers on iron chains from a crenellated gatehouse, swinging from upright to flat across a rippling moat to the far bank

styles.name: torch-flame
styles.description: A row of wall torches in iron brackets lights one by one; each teardrop flame flickers yellow-orange-red and throws rising sparks

styles.name: potion-brew
styles.description: Corked round-bottom glass flasks fill one by one with red, blue, green and violet potions; bubbles rise through the brew and full flasks glint

styles.name: treasure-chest
styles.description: An iron-banded wooden treasure chest with a gold lock: the domed lid lifts with progress to reveal a glittering heap of gold, sparkles twinkling around it

styles.name: scroll-unroll
styles.description: A parchment scroll unrolls between two rolls with wooden end-caps, revealing lines of handwritten script; the travelling roll turns as it goes

styles.name: portcullis
styles.description: A spiked iron portcullis lattice rattles up into a crenellated stone gatehouse, clearing the arched gateway; torches flicker either side

styles.name: anvil-forge
styles.description: A blacksmith's hammer rises and strikes a red-hot blade on an iron anvil, sparks flying; the blade is beaten longer with progress, cooling to steel behind the glowing tip

styles.name: banner-unfurl
styles.description: A red heraldic banner with a gold stripe unfurls from a tall pole with a gold finial, streaming further with progress and rippling in the wind, its end cut swallow-tail
